FEAT-2-S90.title: Define Specialty Query Schema and Validation
FEAT-2-S90.description: Create Pydantic models for specialty input parsing and validation, including normalized query text, extracted keywords, and structured specialty request format for downstream processing.

FEAT-2-S91.title: Expose Specialty Identification via FindCare Facade
FEAT-2-S91.description: Integrate specialty_service into find_care_facade and tool_router, enabling specialty identification to be triggered via tool calls and returning structured NUCC codes to calling workflows.

FEAT-2-S92.title: Load and Normalize NUCC Specialty Taxonomy Data
FEAT-2-S92.description: Implement ingestion and normalization of NUCC taxonomy codes used for specialty mapping, ensuring consistent formatting, deduplication keys, and lookup readiness for the specialty_service.
